direction: straight down with her, 0.85 m to 0.30 m, no lateral or rotational component
speed: 0.55 m of drop in about 1.4 s (≈0.4 m/s), started as she arrives and finished as her knees hit the spoil

constraint_honoured: 'Already framed to rhyme with the earth tunnel of S03' — the move exists only to deliver the black oval at the height and size the S03 opener needs.
movement_note: Licensed move (a) extended to her drop rather than her run: the camera lies down when she does (camera-height law). One axis only, and it is finished well before the 3.0 s is out.
